E1.yt_title: You woke up in 1294. What do you do? 🐫 Wrong Century Ep.1 #shorts
E1.yt_description:
Episode 1 — Wrong Century
You fell asleep in 2026. You woke up in a Silk Road caravanserai in Tabriz, 1294 — and a caravan master thinks you're his new guard.

🗳️ Comment A or B — Episode 2 follows the vote.
A = Play the guard · B = Run into the city

📜 History note: Tabriz was the Ilkhanate's great trading hub, where Venetian, Genoese, Armenian and Persian merchants met.

E2a.yt_title: The Khan just invented paper money 💸 Wrong Century Ep.2 #shorts
E2a.yt_description:
Episode 2 — Paper Money
You played the guard. Now the Khan's herald announces paper money — and refusing it is punishable by death.

🗳️ Comment A or B — Episode 3 follows the vote.
A = Spend it now · B = Save it

📜 History note: In September 1294 the Ilkhan Gaykhatu introduced 'chao', paper money copied from Yuan China, in Tabriz. Merchants shut their shops and it was withdrawn within about two months.

E3a.yt_title: Night one on the Silk Road. You have a lighter. 🔥 Wrong Century Ep.3 #shorts
E3a.yt_description:
Episode 3 — Fire
You spent the paper money. Five days east of Tabriz, the wood is wet, a child is freezing — and there's a plastic lighter in your pocket nobody here has ever seen.

🗳️ Comment A or B — Episode 4 follows the vote.
A = Use the lighter · B = Keep the secret

📜 History note: Caravans on this road covered roughly 4–6 farsakhs a day, and in October the Azerbaijan highlands are already cold and wet. Fire was made with flint, steel and tinder.

E4a.yt_title: Bandits on the Silk Road. And you're the guard. ⚔️ Wrong Century Ep.4 #shorts
E4a.yt_description:
Episode 4 — Stones From Above
You used the lighter. A freezing boy got warm, and Faraj saw everything. Two days later, in a mountain pass near Miyane, bandits roll stones down onto the caravan. You have a sword you can't hold, and a phone at 23%.

🗳️ Comment A or B — Episode 5 follows the vote.
A = Fight with the sword · B = Use the phone

📜 History note: In Ilkhanid Iran, mountain passes were a favourite place for ambushes: bandits, often army deserters and outlaws, rolled stones down on caravans from above. Road patrols called tangaul guarded the routes.

E5a.yt_title: The real guard just showed up. And you're wearing his job. 🐎 Wrong Century Ep.5 #shorts
E5a.yt_description:
Episode 5 — The Real Guard
You fought with the sword. Badly. You took a cut, but the caravan survived, and Bahram finally nods at you. Then, at the Zanjan caravanserai, Arslan rides in: the Kipchak guard who was really hired in Tabriz. He wants his job and his pay. The same day, a yam courier brings news: the Khan's paper money is withdrawn. Your seven saved chao are now souvenirs.

🗳️ Comment A or B — Episode 6 follows the vote.
A = Confess and become Hovhannes's apprentice · B = Pay Arslan off with future wages

📜 History note: Gaykhatu's paper money, the chao, was introduced in Tabriz in September 1294 and withdrawn by November after markets shut down. News moved fast across the Ilkhanate thanks to the yam, the Mongol relay-post system of stations with fresh horses.
#WrongCentury #SilkRoad #InteractiveStory #History #ChooseYourPath
E5a.caption:
The man you're pretending to be just rode in. 🐎 And your seven paper notes just became worthless. 📜
